title: Formalizing geometric measure theory
abstract: A development of foundations and central results in geometric measure theory, including Hausdorff content and density bounds, weak convergence and compactness for Radon measures, tangent-measure machinery, Mattila's Lemmas 14.5--14.7, and Marstrand's integrality theorem for positive finite densities.

informal.mattila_14_10: If a Radon measure on Euclidean n-space has positive finite s-dimensional density on a set of positive measure, then s is a natural number.
informal.mattila_14_11: Every n-uniform measure on Euclidean n-space is a constant multiple of Lebesgue measure.
informal.MeasureTheory.Measure.weaklyConverges_if: Vague convergence of Radon measures on Euclidean space is equivalent to the Portmanteau compact-set upper and open-set lower bounds.
informal.MeasureTheory.exists_vaguelyConvergent_s: A sequence of Radon measures on Euclidean space that is uniformly bounded on every compact set has a vaguely convergent subsequence.
